title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Company Description**
OptimumAI is a research-first, mission-driven organization focused on building infrastructure for human consciousness development at scale. The company develops AI that measures, challenges, and strengthens authentic human agency rather than replacing it. OptimumAI is building the Agency Engine, a platform designed to help individuals and organizations unlock higher levels of awareness, responsibility, and performance. Team members join a pioneering environment that combines advanced technology, behavioral science, and ethical innovation. Those interested in learning more about the company’s work can follow OptimumAI on YouTube.

**Role Description**
The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) will serve as a strategic partner to leadership, providing guidance on HR policies, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness. Day-to-day responsibilities include advising on employee relations matters, supporting performance management processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment laws. The HRBP will collaborate with managers to develop and implement HR initiatives that align with business goals, including talent development, feedback frameworks, and culture-building programs. This contract role is fully remote and requires regular collaboration across time zones using digital tools and virtual meetings. The HRBP will also contribute to HR process improvement, documentation, and data-informed decision-making to support a high-performing, mission-aligned team.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in Human Resources (HR) and HR Policies, with the ability to interpret and apply HR frameworks to support business objectives.
* Strong Employee Relations skills, including coaching managers, resolving conflicts, and supporting engagement and retention initiatives.
* Solid understanding of Labor and Employment Law, with experience maintaining compliance in a remote or distributed workforce environment.
* Proficiency in Performance Management, including goal setting, feedback processes, and performance improvement strategies.
* Proven experience as an HR Business Partner or similar strategic HR role, ideally in a tech, startup, or research-focused environment.
* Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels.
* Comfort working in a remote, fast-evolving setting, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field; HR certifications (e.g., SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR) are a plus.
* Interest in human development, organizational psychology, or mission-driven work related to human agency and consciousness is highly beneficial.

**Company:**
 OptimumAI

**Compensation:**
 Up to ₹3 LPA per annum

**Work Mode:**
 Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
 Full Time

title: Workforce Support Specialist [T500-30254]
description:
**About Visy:**

Visy is a family-owned Australian business and a global pioneer in sustainable packaging, recycling and logistics. They operate across 150 sites globally, including operations in Asia, Europe, and the USA, supported by a dedicated workforce of over 7,000 employees. It is Australia and New Zealand’s largest manufacturer of food and beverage packaging, made from household recycling. As Australia’s largest recycler, it processes 40% of Australian households recycling. Visy also supports customers with logistics, packaging supplies, point of sale displays and more. At Visy India, their technology hub in Hyderabad, they are expanding their technical capabilities to support their global business.

**Position Summary:**

The Workforce Support Specialist provides administrative and operational support to the Visy Workforce team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance and workforce administration activities.

Working closely with Workforce Consultants and business stakeholders in Australia, this role helps maintain accurate workforce records, supports compliance requirements, coordinates onboarding activities and provides reporting and workforce data support. The position plays an important role in ensuring workforce information is accurate and up to date to support effective workforce planning and decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide administrative and coordination support to Workforce Consultants and workforce programs.
* Coordinate recruitment and onboarding activities, including documentation, pre-employment checks and systems administration.
* Support candidate management, interview scheduling and recruitment administration.
* Maintain accurate workforce records, including licenses, training, inductions and compliance documentation.
* Monitor compliance requirements, track upcoming expiries, coordinate renewals and follow up on outstanding actions.
* Prepare and maintain workforce reports, dashboards and workforce data.
* Support contingent workforce administration and labour supplier processes.
* Assist with workforce planning, process improvements and workforce projects.
* Contribute to compliance reviews, audits and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Challenges:**

* Managing high volumes of workforce administration while maintaining accuracy and service levels.
* Coordinating compliance and onboarding activities across multiple locations and stakeholder groups.
* Maintaining accurate workforce data and ensuring compliance requirements are met within required timeframes.

**Key Relationships:**

* Primary Functional Peers/Manager
* National Operations Manager – Workforce

**Key Stakeholders:**

**Internal to Visy:**

* Workforce Consultants
* National Operations Manager – Workforce
* People & Culture Team
* Site Operations Managers
* Training and Safety Teams

**External to Visy:**

* Job Seekers and Candidates
* Labour Hire Providers
* Pre-employment Check Providers
* Training and Induction Providers
* Workforce Australia/Employment Service Providers
* Visy Panel Agencies
* Other Contingent Workforce Partners

**Key Requirements:**

**Experience and Qualifications:**

**Mandatory:**

* Qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in workforce coordination, recruitment administration, HR administration or a similar support environment.
* Experience maintaining workforce, compliance and onboarding records.
* Experience preparing reports and managing workforce data.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-volume administrative environment.

**Desirable:**

* Experience supporting contingent workforce or labour hire programs.
* Experience working with Australian employment, recruitment or compliance processes.
* Experience using HR, recruitment, workforce management or compliance systems.
* Exposure to workforce planning, reporting or workforce analytics.

**Skills:**

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and focus on data accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and build effective working relationships across remote teams.
* Customer-focused approach with strong stakeholder support skills.
* Strong problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset.
* Intermediate Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Ability to learn and use HR, recruitment and workforce management systems.

title: Principal Consultant - Managed Services (Oracle Cloud HCM Functional - Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting)

A Principal Consultant Client Services at Argano plays a crucial role in shaping the direction of the Client Services family. They are responsible for managing and enhancing relationships with mid-to-large clients to ensure their satisfaction, retention, and continued business with the company. They are involved in setting strategic goals, leading mid to large size client initiatives, and providing expert guidance to both clients and internal teams and providing advanced technical support and configurations when requested. They act as a bridge between the client and Argano, ensuring that client needs are understood and met. A Principal Consultant is constantly implementing and testing enhancements as well as new functionality.
**This position requires module expertise in Oracle HCM Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting. Additional modules are a plus.**
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain regular communication with mid to large size clients to understand their needs, concerns, and feedback. Respond promptly to client inquiries and resolve issues in a timely manner.
* Align existing client practices and procedures with validated HCM Cloud methods to solve client needs and challenges.
* Troubleshoot issues.
* Propose a best practice solution to resolve challenges.
* Identify business requirements and map them to the Oracle Cloud functionality.
* Identify functionality gaps and develop solutions to them, through process or design.
* Configure the Oracle Cloud to meet client requirements and document application set-ups.

* Lead and present to clients and internally

* Lead and support clients with the execution of test scripts.
* Participate in internal forums for training, teamwork, issue resolution and innovative design.
* Provide knowledge transfer to clients.
* Create specification documents for technical object development.
* Be leaders with a vision in the Oracle Cloud space with innovative solutions around the product.
* Constant Implementation and testing of advanced enhancements as well as new functionality.
* Manage and oversee client accounts, including contract renewals, upselling, and cross-selling products or services.
* Develop account plans to maximize value for both the client and Argano.
* Focuses on maintenance, reconfiguration, new functionality or modules.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction by delivering exceptional client service and addressing any client issues or complaints.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business goals and objectives. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to help clients achieve their goals through the company's products or services.
* Work closely with internal sales, marketing, Project managers, etc. to align client needs with Argano’s offerings.
* Prepare and present regular reports to management and clients, outlining key performance metrics and the status of client accounts.

**Education**
**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.) expected.

**Experience**

* 5 - 10 years of Managed Services experience in Multi Client environment.
* Module-specific experience in Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting.
* Demonstrated experience in understanding business practice concepts in your modules of expertise.
* Track record of building long-lasting relationships with your clients
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* 3 full life cycle Oracle HCM Cloud implementations
* Ability to understand fundamental system design and purpose.
* Ability to engage effectively at the business and technical level.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Oracle certified in your modules of expertise.

* Strong interpersonal skills
* Knowledge of challenges commonly faced by client and support teams.
* Ability to work well autonomously and in a team environment.
* Ability to effectively manage priorities and multiple clients.
* Self-motivated and able to plan work effort and manage priorities.
* Experience Leading and managing mid-size client projects independently.
* Experience providing complex solutions to clients.
* Proven track record of successful project management and client satisfaction.

**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
  
  
Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Centered on five core issues, this Portfolio signifies to the market that we see Human Capital as a topic critical to the C-Suite. Manager

We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Overview**
The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.
  
  
This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast-evolving compliance landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting & Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:

+ Gratuity Act
+ Shops & Establishments Act (state-specific)
+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
+ Leave-related statutory provisions
+ Severance and separation-related compliance

* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops & Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations & HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications And Requirements**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4-7+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state-specific regulations including Shops & Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* Judgement and Integrity: Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* Collaboration & Communication: Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* Adaptability: Operates effectively in dynamic, fast-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* Operational Excellence: Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: Placement Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Chennais Amirta International Institute of Hotel Management (CAIIHM) is a leading hospitality education institution in India, established in 2010 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The institute has grown from a single branch with 300 students and 10 staff members to educating over 12,000 graduates by 2018. CAIIHM operates college campuses in Chennai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad, along with admission offices in 16 cities across South India, supported by more than 300 faculty members and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The institute maintains industry partnerships with over 180 star hotels, enabling strong placement support and industrial exposure for students. Chennais Amirta is certified by multiple academic and professional bodies, including Bharathiar University, Alagappa University, Annamalai University, IPD–OUM Malaysia, London School of Business & Finance (Singapore), and Bharat Sevak Samaj.
  
**Role Description**
The Placement Manager is responsible for overseeing and coordinating all student placement activities, with a focus on building and maintaining strong partnerships with hospitality industry employers. This full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad includes identifying placement opportunities, organizing campus interviews, and aligning student profiles with suitable job openings. The role involves regular interaction with students to understand their career goals, provide guidance on interview preparation, and monitor placement outcomes. The Placement Manager will collaborate with faculty and administration to integrate industry requirements into training plans and ensure timely reporting on placement metrics and employer feedback.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and networking skills to engage with hotel and hospitality partners.
* Experience in placement coordination, career services, or talent acquisition, preferably in education or hospitality.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with students, employers, and internal teams.
* Organizational and planning abilities for managing placement drives, events, and employer outreach activities.
* Analytical skills to track placement data, generate reports, and improve placement strategies based on outcomes.
* Knowledge of the hospitality industry and current hiring trends; prior experience in hotel management or related fields is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Proficiency in MS Office or similar tools for documentation, reporting, and communication.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad and collaborate with multiple campuses and stakeholders.

title: Head of People Partnering, UK & Europe
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**
The
**People Partnering team at Tide**
plays a pivotal role in driving business success by acting as strategic advisors and coaches to leaders at all levels. We provide expert guidance on organisational design, talent development, employee relations, and engagement, ensuring a positive and high-performance culture. Embedded within the business, we use data-driven insights to shape policies, pre-empt workforce challenges, and lead high-impact initiatives that enable Tideans to do work they love.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Head of People Partnering for UK & Europe, you will:
  
  

* Design and implement a People Partnering strategy for the Tide’s UK & Europe business that supports business objectives, enhances the employee experience, and fosters a high-performance culture.
* Act as a strategic partner and advisor to the CEO of Tide’s UK & Europe business and the UK & Europe management team, providing expert guidance on organisational design, workforce planning, performance management, and employee relations.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of People Partners, ensuring they are equipped to support leaders and teams across various markets. Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Support business leaders in driving organisational change, equipping them with the necessary people management tools to ensure smooth transitions and sustained business performance.
* Partner with business leaders and the Director of People Experience to drive employee engagement, interpret survey insights, and implement targeted action plans to enhance team satisfaction, retention, and productivity.
* Ensure HR policies and programs align with relevant employment laws and industry best practices while managing cross-border employment complexities.
* Use HR analytics to inform people strategies, track key workforce metrics, and present actionable insights to business leaders.
* Oversee performance management, career development, and succession planning initiatives to build a strong talent pipeline and support internal mobility.
* Provide direct coaching to managers on complex employee relations matters, leadership development, and team effectiveness.
* Embed diversity, equity, and inclusion across all aspects of people partnering, ensuring it remains a core pillar of talent, engagement, and leadership strategies.
* Upholding and promoting the values of Tide in all interactions and decisions.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Progressive HR experience, including direct partnership with SVPs / C-Suite leaders.
* Extensive experience partnering with cross-cultural leadership teams.
* Experience with line management of both junior and senior People Partners.
* Good understanding of global HR practices and employment laws, particularly in India and various European countries.
* Strong client focus with outstanding judgement, critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to align HR strategies with business goals.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change at pace and foster a positive organisational culture.
* Ideally experience leading HR for a commercial and operations client groups (not essential).

**What You’ll Get In Return**
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
  
  

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
  
  
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
  
  
*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**

* Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Sr Associate Benefits
description:
**ABOUT AMGEN**
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
  
  
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the
  
  
Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Benefits Strategy Implementation**

* Support the day-to-day operational activities associated with employee benefits programs, which may include medical, insurance, retirement, leave, wellness and other benefits and perquisites for JAPAC and ELMAC regions.
* Translate approved regional and global benefits strategies into implementation activities, operational processes, and deliverables across assigned markets.
* Conduct benchmarking and market research to support recommendations for program enhancements.
* Coordinate implementation of approved benefit design changes and new initiatives.
* Support benefits activities related to mergers, acquisitions, and organizational integrations, including benefit comparisons, implementation planning, and operational transitions.

**Program Management & Operations**

* Manage recurring benefits processes including annual renewals, enrolment activities, vendor updates, and program changes.
* Coordinate defined benefits projects and workstreams, establish timelines and priorities, track milestones, identify risks, and escalate issues requiring broader decisions.
* Analyse operational issues of moderate complexity, evaluate alternatives using established policies and precedents, recommend solutions, and coordinate implementation of agreed actions.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, controls, project plans, and operating procedures to support effective program delivery.

**Vendor & Broker Management**

* Serve as an operational point of contact for assigned vendors and brokers.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service requirements, deliverables, and timelines.
* Investigate service issues, coordinate corrective actions, and escalate significant risks as appropriate.
* Facilitate vendor governance meetings, track action plans, and ensure timely resolution of open items.
* Support procurements, contract renewals, implementations, transitions, and third-party risk management activities.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Apply established benefits governance requirements and operational controls across assigned activities.
* Maintain benefits documentation, process records, governance materials, and audit evidence.
* Identify potential compliance, control, or operational risks and coordinate appropriate remediation activities.
* Support regulatory change implementation by coordinating operational updates and stakeholder actions.
* Support internal and external audits through data collection, documentation, and issue resolution activities.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Analyse benefits cost, utilization, participation, employee experience, and vendor performance data.
* Interpret trends and translate findings into actionable recommendations for Benefits Managers and stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance metrics.
* Support program evaluation, benchmarking activities, and business case development.
* Prepare analyses and insights for leadership reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder decision-making.

**Employee Experience & Communications**

* Partner with Benefits Operations and Communications teams to deliver benefits education and engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate communication activities related to benefit changes, annual enrolment, and employee awareness campaigns.
* Review benefits materials for operational accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Use employee feedback, service metrics, and operational insights to identify opportunities to enhance the employee experience.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Establish effective working relationships with HR Operations, Finance, Legal, Procurement, brokers, vendors, and regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to support timely and accurate benefits delivery.
* Facilitate issue resolution and alignment across stakeholders involved in benefits operations and projects.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically, 5+ years of experience in benefits, total rewards, HR operations, or a related field.
* Experience administering or coordinating employee benefits programs.
* Experience working with benefits vendors, consultants, brokers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including interpretation of benefits and operational data.
* Knowledge of benefits governance, compliance requirements, and operational controls.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and exercise judgment within established policies and procedures.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting benefits programs across multiple countries or regions.
* Experience with global benefits operations, vendor governance, and program implementation.
* Exposure to healthcare, insurance, retirement, and wellbeing program administration.

title: HR Risk & Compliance Manager
description:
This role is open in multiple locations and benefits vary based on the location of hire.
  
  
**About Flutter Entertainment**
Flutter Entertainment is the
**world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator**
with
**15.9 million**
Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of
**$16.4 billion**
in 2025. We have a
**portfolio of iconic brands**
, including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.
  
  
Flutter Entertainment is listed on the
**New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).**
We’re proud to be recognized by
**TIME**
as one of the
**World’s Best Companies 2025**
— a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  
  
Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing
**portfolio of brands**
across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
The HR Risk & Compliance Manager is a pivotal mid-level leadership role within Flutter's Group HR Operations & Transformation department, serving as a trusted strategic partner to HR leadership and the broader executive team.
  
  
As Flutter continues to scale its global footprint, this role provides the essential oversight and subject matter expertise required to navigate an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory landscape — translating legal and compliance obligations into practical, operationally sound HR practices that protect both the organization and its employees.
  
  
At its core, the HR Risk & Compliance Manager is responsible for ongoing, recording and managing risk registers, Controls, Issues, actions on Flutter Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tool for Group HR Operations & Transformation.
  
  
This encompasses the full lifecycle of compliance activity — from horizon-scanning for emerging regulatory changes and conduct structured risk assessments, through to designing and embedding policies, procedures, and controls that align with global employment law standards, data protection obligations, and Flutter's defined organizational risk appetite.
  
  
The role requires a practitioner who can operate with equal confidence at a strategic level — advising senior stakeholders on risk exposure and compliance posture — and at a detailed operational level, ensuring that day-to-day HR processes consistently meet their regulatory and ethical obligations.
  
  
A central pillar of this role is deep subject matter expertise across multi-jurisdictional employment law and data privacy regulation.
  
  
**Accountabilities & Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance**

* Monitor and ensure ongoing adherence to employment legislation across all jurisdictions in which the organization operates.
* Proactively assess regulatory changes — including amendments to wage and hour laws, termination requirements, leave entitlements, and worker classification rules — and translate these into actionable policy updates and operational guidance within required implementation timelines.
* Provide authoritative, risk-informed guidance to HR Business Partners, People Leaders, and senior management on complex employment matters
* Serve as the primary internal subject matter expert on employment standards, maintaining a current and comprehensive register of statutory obligations across all active jurisdictions and flagging emerging regulatory risks to senior management.

GRC Record Maintenance
  
  

* Design, implement, and continuously maintain a comprehensive HR Governance, Risk, and Compliance framework that aligns with recognised standards
* Establish, document, and record internal controls including sox controls covering the full employee lifecycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management, data handling, and offboarding — ensuring each control is mapped to its underlying regulatory obligation.
* Maintain a live GRC register that captures all applicable regulatory requirements, assigned control owners, control testing schedules, and remediation actions, providing leadership with a transparent and auditable view of the organisation's HR compliance status at any given time.
* Ensure that compliance requirements are clearly communicated across the organisation and that accountabilities for policy adherence are embedded within role descriptions, manager onboarding materials, and departmental operating procedures.

**Risk Assessment & Mitigation**

* Conduct structured, periodic HR process risk assessments across all HR operations & Transformation processes and geographies, utilising both qualitative and quantitative methodologies to identify compliance gaps, operational vulnerabilities, and areas of elevated legal exposure.
* Develop and execute targeted risk mitigation strategies for identified findings, assigning clear ownership, remediation timelines, and success metrics; monitor progress against agreed action plans and escalate unresolved or high-severity risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Prepare clear, concise risk reports and compliance dashboards for presentation to senior leadership, the HR Director, and board-level oversight committees, translating technical compliance findings into business-relevant risk language that supports informed decision-making.
* Maintain a dynamic HR risk register that is reviewed and updated on a defined cadence (at minimum quarterly), incorporating changes in the regulatory environment, organisational structure, workforce composition, and operational footprint.
* Conduct Risk & Control self-assessment (RCSA) for all Group HR operation & Transformation processes

Compliance Auditing & Monitoring
  
  

* Plan and execute a structured programme of internal HR compliance reviews covering key risk areas including right-to-work verification, payroll compliance etc.
* Develop audit methodologies, sampling frameworks, and test scripts appropriate to each audit area; document findings in formal audit reports that clearly articulate the nature of any non-compliance, the associated risk level, and recommended corrective actions with defined remediation timelines.
* Implement a continuous compliance monitoring programme — distinct from periodic auditing — that provides real-time or near-real-time visibility into key compliance indicators, such as training completion rates, policy acknowledgement status, and the timeliness of disciplinary process documentation.
* Track and report on the status of all corrective actions arising from internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and self-identified compliance gaps, ensuring that remediation is completed within agreed timeframes and that repeat findings are escalated appropriately.

**Regulatory Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain a comprehensive and well-organised compliance documentation repository, ensuring that all policies, audit records, risk assessments, training logs, regulatory correspondence, and incident reports are retained in accordance with applicable data retention requirements and are readily accessible for regulatory inspection or internal review.
* Develop and maintain a regulatory reporting calendar that captures all recurring submission deadlines across jurisdictions, with sufficient lead time built in for data collection, validation, and sign-off by relevant stakeholders.

Training & Awareness Programs
  
  

* Design and deliver a comprehensive HR compliance training curriculum for three distinct audiences: HR professionals requiring in-depth knowledge of compliance obligations and processes; people managers requiring practical guidance on legally compliant decision-making; and all employees requiring foundational awareness of key compliance topics.
* Develop engaging, jurisdiction-appropriate training content covering priority compliance areas including GDPR and data protection obligations, anti-discrimination and equal opportunity requirements, anti-harassment and respectful workplace standards, whistleblowing procedures, and applicable health and safety responsibilities — leveraging a blend of e-learning modules, live workshops, and written guidance materials.
* Establish a training tracking and reporting mechanism that monitors completion rates by business unit, role level, and geography; identify and follow up on gaps in completion; and produce regular training compliance reports for HR leadership that demonstrate the organisation's investment in a culture of compliance.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through post-training assessments, employee surveys, and trend analysis of compliance incidents and policy breaches, using insights to continuously improve content, delivery methods, and targeting of awareness campaigns.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the HR function's primary compliance liaison to Legal, Finance, IT, Data Privacy, Internal Audit, and operational business units, ensuring that HR compliance considerations are embedded into organisational processes, system implementations, and strategic initiatives from the outset rather than as an afterthought.
* Support merger, acquisition, and corporate restructuring activities by leading HR compliance due diligence workstreams — assessing the target organisation's employment law compliance status, workforce liabilities, policy frameworks, and data protection practices — and providing structured findings and risk assessments to the deal team and senior leadership.
* Coordinate with external legal advisors, specialist employment counsel, data protection consultants, and HR compliance specialists as required, managing these relationships effectively to ensure timely, cost-efficient, and high-quality advice that is appropriately integrated into internal compliance processes.
* Champion a cross-functional approach to compliance culture, proactively identifying opportunities to align HR compliance initiatives with broader organisational governance programmes and contributing to enterprise-wide risk and compliance forums, committees, and reporting processes.

**Skills & Capabilities**
Success in this role requires a well-rounded combination of technical expertise, analytical capability, and interpersonal effectiveness. The ideal candidate will bring both the specialist knowledge to navigate complex regulatory environments and the professional maturity to influence organizational behavior at all levels.
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* The role requires a deep and current understanding of employment law and HR regulations across multiple jurisdictions, including familiarity with region-specific frameworks such as the EU's Working Time Directive, the UK Employment Rights Act, the US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), and equivalent standards in other applicable geographies.
* A strong command of data protection legislation is essential, particularly the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and its national implementations, as well as comparable privacy frameworks such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other local privacy laws that intersect with HR data processing activities.
* The role further demands hands-on familiarity with GRC methodologies — including risk registers, control frameworks, and compliance lifecycle management — alongside practical experience operating HR information systems (HRIS) and dedicated compliance management platforms such as Workday.

**Risk Management & Analytical Thinking**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven capability to identify, assess, and prioritize compliance risks across the full spectrum of HR operations — from recruitment and onboarding through to termination and post-employment obligations
* The Candidate should have the ability to conduct structured risk assessments, develop evidence-based mitigation strategies, and monitor the effectiveness of controls over time.
* The Candidate should have the ability to translate dense and often ambiguous regulatory requirements into clear, practical, and operationally viable solutions — bridging the gap between legal obligation and day-to-day HR practice without creating unnecessary organizational friction.
* Handle SOX & Audit sessions as a bridge between HR operations & Audit teams.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are a non-negotiable requirement.
* The HR Risk & Compliance Manager will regularly engage with a diverse range of audiences — from senior executives and legal counsel to frontline managers and individual employees — and must be able to calibrate the complexity and tone of compliance guidance accordingly.
* This includes the ability to produce clear policy documents, concise audit reports, and compelling training materials, as well as the confidence to present risk findings and recommendations to leadership.
* Strong relationship-building capabilities will be essential in fostering a culture of compliance across geographically dispersed teams.

**Project Management & Organizational Effectiveness**

* The breadth of this role demands exceptional organizational discipline and the ability to manage multiple concurrent compliance workstreams without compromising quality or accuracy.

This experience should demonstrate a consistent track record of managing compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously — not merely exposure to a single domestic market.

Candidates with meaningful exposure to data protection and privacy compliance, including practical application of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or equivalent frameworks such as the CCPA, will hold a distinct advantage given the intersection of HR data handling and privacy obligations in this role.
  
  
Experience conducting or supporting compliance audits, internal controls reviews, or regulatory inspections is also preferred, as is familiarity with compliance management software platforms such as Archer, Audit board technology solutions that streamline monitoring and reporting workflows.

**Job Summary**
The Senior Associate Compensation oversees the design, implementation, governance, and administration of compensation programs aligned with the organization’s talent strategy and business goals. The position works closely with People & Culture, Finance, business leaders, and HRIS teams to ensure programs are competitive, equitable, compliant, financially responsible, and consistently applied.

* Partner with People & Culture, Finance, HRIS, payroll, recruiters, and business leaders on compensation decisions, internal equity, organizational design, and process execution.
* Develop dashboards, executive-ready analyses, and recurring reports that translate compensation data into actionable insights.
* Maintain compensation policies, documentation, audit controls, pay equity support, and compliance practices while handling confidential information with discretion.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 4+ years of progressive experience in compensation or total rewards, with direct responsibility for job architecture, market pricing, compensation surveys, and annual compensation cycles.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining salary structures, grades, ranges, and job-leveling frameworks.
* Strong understanding of compensation principles, market data analysis, internal equity, pay governance, and relevant regulations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis; experience with HRIS and compensation planning platforms required (UKG experience preferred).
* Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or similar credential preferred.
* Experience supporting international or multi-jurisdictional employee populations preferred.
* Demonstrated analytical skills and sound business judgment.
* Strong project and process management abilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and consultative partnership skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive-level communication.
* High attention to detail, data accuracy, and internal controls.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sensitive decisions.
* Commitment to fairness, consistency, confidentiality, and continuous improvement.

Trimont is an equal opportunity employer, and we are proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process or use of our website, please contact us. Trimont maintains a drug-free workplace and is committed to providing a safe, secure, and productive environment for all team members.

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented HR & Recruitment Manager to manage the complete human resources function, including IT recruitment, talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, and employee relations.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in recruiting IT professionals, managing end-to-end recruitment processes, implementing HR policies, ensuring statutory compliance, and developing effective HR strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from manpower planning and sourcing to interviewing, salary negotiation, and onboarding.
* Recruit IT professionals for various roles, including Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, Java Developers, .NET Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Business Analysts, Project Managers, and IT Support Engineers.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment agencies, and other channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, coordinate technical interviews, and evaluate candidate suitability.
* Work closely with technical managers and department heads to understand job requirements and hiring priorities.
* Negotiate compensation packages and manage offer releases, follow-ups, and joining formalities.
* Maintain a recruitment database, candidate pipeline, and hiring reports.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance rate, and joining ratio.

**B. HR Operations & Administration**

* Manage employee onboarding, induction, documentation, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee records, personnel files, attendance, leave records, and HR databases.
* Develop, implement, and update HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks.
* Coordinate payroll processing, salary inputs, reimbursements, and employee benefits with the finance team.
* Handle employee queries, grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace concerns.
* Manage employee separation, exit interviews, full and final settlements, and clearance procedures.

**C. Employee Engagement & Retention**

* Develop initiatives to improve employee satisfaction, motivation, and retention.
* Organize employee engagement activities, celebrations, training programs, and team-building initiatives.
* Conduct employee feedback sessions and exit interviews.
* Identify employee retention challenges and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and professional workplace culture.

**D. Performance & Training Management**

* Coordinate annual and periodic performance appraisal processes.
* Establish performance review procedures in consultation with management.
* Identify training and development requirements for employees.
* Support career development, succession planning, and employee growth initiatives.
* Monitor probation reviews, confirmation processes, and performance improvement plans.

**E. HR Compliance & Statutory Requirements**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, employment regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, bonus, and other applicable statutory matters with payroll or compliance specialists.
* Maintain employment contracts, HR documentation, and statutory records as applicable.
* Support internal audits, HR audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of employee information.

**F. HR Strategy & Management Reporting**

* Prepare monthly HR reports covering headcount, recruitment status, attrition, attendance, and employee costs.
* Develop manpower plans in line with business requirements and project demands.
* Establish HR KPIs and recruitment targets.
* Advise management on workforce planning, organizational development, compensation, and employee relations.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes through HRMS, ATS, and other HR technology solutions.

**3. Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* Minimum 2-3 years of relevant HR experience, including substantial IT recruitment experience.
* Experience in managing both recruitment and general HR operations.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of IT recruitment and technical job requirements.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong candidate sourcing, screening, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience with job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, and HRMS platforms.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and HR priorities simultaneously.
* High standards of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Time-to-fill and time-to-hire.
* Recruitment target achievement.
* Quality of hire and offer-to-joining ratio.
* Recruitment cost per hire.
* Employee attrition and retention rates.
* Employee engagement and satisfaction.
* Timely payroll coordination and HR documentation.
* Compliance completion and accuracy of HR records.
* Completion of performance appraisals and probation reviews.

**6. Preferred Experience**

* Experience working in an IT services company, software development company, or technology consulting organization.
* Experience recruiting for technical and non-technical positions.
* Experience managing recruitment teams and coordinating with senior management.
* Familiarity with project-based hiring, urgent resource requirements, and bulk recruitment.

**7. Personal Attributes**

* Proactive, responsible, and target-oriented.
* Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities.
* Professional approach to employee relations and conflict resolution.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with management.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and fostering a positive workplace.

* Design and administer competitive compensation, total rewards, benchmarking, and performance management frameworks tailored for technical manufacturing environments.
* Partner directly with executive leadership to shape organizational design, workforce scaling, and long-term labor strategy.
* Own key operational metrics including employee retention, plant harmony indices, compliance scores, and critical technical time-to-fill targets.

* 15 to 22 years of progressive HR experience within manufacturing, aerospace, or defense sectors.
* At least 5 to 6 years operating at the AGM, DGM, or General Manager level.
* MBA or MHRM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.
* Strong expertise in industrial relations (IR), labor laws, and statutory compliance within heavy manufacturing environments.

* Experience scaling greenfield or expansion-stage manufacturing facilities.

A. Experience leading compensation administration or total rewards delivery within a global or shared-services environment

title: Sr. Hr operations and Benefits Specialist
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self-healing, self-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
  
  
We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For…**
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Benefits & HR Operations Specialist to join our People team in Hyderabad, India. This role will play a key part in supporting our global employees, with primary responsibility for benefits administration and significant hands-on ownership of global HR operations across the employee lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience administering employee benefits in India, working knowledge of U.S. benefits programs and practices, and substantial prior experience independently administering core employee lifecycle processes in a global organization. You’ll serve as a trusted resource for employees, helping them navigate benefits, leave programs, onboarding, employment changes, offboarding, and other HR processes while partnering closely with our global People team, Payroll, Finance, benefits brokers, carriers, and other external vendors.
  
  
Beyond benefits, this is a senior, hands-on HR Operations role. The successful candidate will have material, prior experience across the employee lifecycle disciplines this position will own, enabling them to quickly establish and maintain a solid, scalable global HR foundation.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing…**
**Benefits Administration – India & U.S.**

* Support the day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs across India and the United States, ensuring employees receive timely and accurate guidance.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for employee questions related to benefits, eligibility, enrollment, qualifying life events, leave programs, and other benefit-related matters.
* Manage and support India benefits programs, including group medical and insurance programs, Provident Fund (PF), Employees' State Insurance (ESI), gratuity, statutory leave and other applicable employee benefits.
* Support administration of U.S. health and welfare programs, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, retirement programs, and other company-sponsored benefits.
* Maintain working knowledge of U.S. benefits requirements and programs, including ERISA, COBRA, ACA and FMLA, and partner with U.S.-based HR team members and vendors on administration and compliance.
* Coordinate and support annual Open Enrollment activities across applicable regions, including employee communications, system updates, enrollment activities, and issue resolution.
* Support leave administration across both countries, partnering with employees, HR team members, Payroll, and third-party administrators as appropriate.
* Process and reconcile benefit enrollments, changes, terminations, dependent updates, and qualifying life events.
* Partner with benefits brokers, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, Payroll, and other vendors to resolve employee questions and discrepancies.
* Support benefit renewals, audits, invoice reconciliation, eligibility reviews, reporting, and data validation.
* Assist with the development and delivery of employee benefits communications, educational materials, and resources.
* Maintain awareness of evolving benefits regulations and statutory requirements in both India and the U.S., escalating compliance questions as appropriate.

**Global HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Administration**

* Independently lead and administer day-to-day global HR operations throughout the employee lifecycle, including pre-employment activities, onboarding, employee changes, transfers, promotions, leaves, and offboarding.
* Own global onboarding administration, including new-hire documentation, data entry, required approvals, policy acknowledgments, background and pre-employment coordination as applicable, benefits and payroll handoffs, and completion tracking.
* Administer employee changes accurately and on time, including job, compensation, manager, location, status, and organizational changes, coordinating closely with Payroll and other stakeholders.
* Lead termination and offboarding processing, including required documentation, HRIS updates, final payroll and benefits coordination, access and equipment notifications, employee communications, and maintenance of appropriate records in accordance with country-specific requirements.
* Process employment verifications and other employee documentation requests accurately, promptly, and with appropriate authorization and confidentiality.
* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready employee data, personnel records, and documentation within the HRIS and other People systems, applying appropriate retention, privacy, and access practices.
* Provide HR compliance and audit support, including document collection, data validation, recurring reporting, employment records, policy acknowledgments, statutory or regulatory submissions, and responses to internal and external requests.
* Respond to general employee HR inquiries, resolve routine operational matters independently, and appropriately escalate employee relations, policy, legal, or complex compliance matters.
* Maintain and continuously improve global HR policies, employee resources, standard operating procedures, checklists, controls, and process documentation, ensuring consistent execution while accounting for country-specific requirements.
* Identify and implement opportunities to streamline, automate, and strengthen benefits and HR operational processes, controls, service levels, and the employee experience; support broader People team projects as business needs evolve.

**Qualities you possess…**

* 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in Benefits, Global HR Operations, Human Resources, or a related field, including meaningful hands-on benefits administration and senior-level ownership of employee lifecycle processes.
* Strong knowledge of India employee benefits and statutory programs, including PF, ESI, gratuity, insurance programs, and applicable leave requirements.
* Working knowledge of U.S. employee benefits, including health and welfare programs, retirement benefits, leave administration, and applicable regulations.
* Familiarity with U.S. benefits regulations such as ERISA, COBRA, ACA, HIPAA, and FMLA is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience independently leading and administering global employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee changes, transfers, promotions, leaves, offboarding and termination processing, employment verifications, personnel records, and routine HR compliance support.
* Material prior experience operating within a global or multi-country HR environment, with the ability to apply consistent processes and controls while appropriately addressing local legal, statutory, cultural, and operational requirements.
* Hands-on experience establishing, documenting, and sustaining scalable global HR operational foundations, including standard operating procedures, checklists, service expectations, controls, data-quality practices, and audit support.
* Experience partnering with insurance providers, benefits brokers, third-party administrators, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT, managers, and other internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience using HRIS, benefits administration, payroll, case-management, and document-management systems, with a record of maintaining accurate, complete, and audit-ready employee data.
* Strong attention to detail, operational discipline, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, employee requests, transactions, and compliance-sensitive processes simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits and HR processes clearly and provide responsive, employee-friendly service across global teams and time zones.
* Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive employee information, combined with a proactive, service-oriented mindset and a focus on process improvement, scalable controls, and employee experience.

*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*

title: Learning & Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Marcus Evans Group**
is a global leader in delivering high-impact business events, strategic conferences, and bespoke business intelligence solutions designed to drive success across industries. With a rich history of over 40 years, we specialize in connecting senior executives with innovative ideas and influential networks that fuel growth and enhance business performance. Our diverse portfolio spans across conferences, summits, training programs, and corporate solutions, all meticulously crafted to address the evolving needs of today’s dynamic business landscape. At the heart of our operations is a commitment to excellence and a passion for fostering connections that lead to actionable insights and transformative outcomes.
  
  
At
**Marcus Evans**
, our people are the cornerstone of our success, and the Global Learning & Quality(L&Q) department is integral to nurturing that cornerstone. Currently, the L&Q team is essential in shaping our workforce through comprehensive new hire training and ongoing professional development. This role is already pivotal, directly influencing our organizational growth and operational excellence.
  
  
Looking ahead, our vision for the Global L&Q department extends far beyond traditional training. We aim to evolve into a strategic partner that drives not only individual growth but also broader business analysis and development. By integrating deeper insights and strategic thinking, the L&Q department will become a central force in guiding organizational success and decision-making, solidifying its position as a key driver of our company's future achievements.
  
  
This is your opportunity to be a central force in elevating our L&Q strategy through analytics excellence, meaningful insights, and a genuine passion for learning both your own and that of those around you.
  
  
This is a role for our
**Hyderabad**
office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Management and Ownership - Manage global L&Q data across business verticals, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and consistency throughout the employee life cycle.
* Reporting and Analytics - Develop, maintain, and deliver regular and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and data visualisations using Power BI, Excel, and other relevant tools to track training, quality, and business performance.
* Business Analysis and Insights - Gather and understand reporting and business requirements, analyse information, identify trends and gaps, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
* Candidate Interaction and Coordination - Communicate with candidates as required, provide relevant information and guidance, coordinate follow-ups, and ensure a professional and consistent candidate experience.
* Training and Knowledge Sharing - Support and deliver training sessions for employees and relevant stakeholders, explain processes and tools clearly, and provide ongoing guidance to support effective adoption.
* Process Improvement - Review existing workflows, reporting practices, and data collection processes; identify opportunities for improvement; and support the implementation of practical solutions that improve efficiency and consistency.
* Programme Evaluation - Review the effectiveness of L&Q programmes using relevant data and feedback, highlighting areas for improvement and supporting continuous learning and quality enhancement.
* Stakeholder Collaboration - Work closely with L&Q teams, business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements, share findings, and ensure reporting and operational activities align with business needs.
* Compliance and Accuracy - Follow applicable data management policies and governance standards, maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and transparency in reporting and data handling.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, reporting, data analysis, training coordination, or a related role, preferably within Learning & Quality or HR.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI, with experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualisations to support business and operational requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Experience gathering, consolidating, validating, and analysing multiple data sets, ensuring accuracy and consistency in reporting.
* Ability to understand business processes, gather requirements, identify improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of effective solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience facilitating or delivering training sessions, providing guidance to participants, and communicating processes and information effectively.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and delivering accurate results within deadlines.
* Quick learner with a proactive and adaptable mindset, open to new technologies, processes, and evolving organisational needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Experience working within a global organisation, with exposure to international business processes, reporting requirements, and stakeholder collaboration.
* Advanced knowledge of data reporting and visualisation tools, including Power BI, CRM platforms, and other relevant business applications, with the ability to leverage technology to improve reporting efficiency and support business requirements.
* Exposure to process improvement initiatives, workflow optimisation, or the development of standardised procedures and reporting practices.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive Salary: A compensation package that reflects your expertise and experience.
* Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home after successfully completing your probation period.
* Incredible Office Culture: Join a workplace that feels like family, where support and camaraderie are part of our DNA.
* Continuous Learning: Access both internal and external training opportunities to enhance your skills and stay ahead in your career.
* Executive-Level Exposure: Collaborate closely with C-level executives and Directors, gaining invaluable insights and experience.
* Global Collaboration: Work with diverse teams across multiple locations, broadening your professional horizon.
* Engaging Office Activities: Participate in dedicated office engagement initiatives that foster a vibrant and dynamic work environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.
