title: Team Lead US
description:
Robert Walters is the world's most trusted talent solutions business. Across the globe, we deliver recruitment, recruitment process outsourcing and advisory services for businesses of all shapes and sizes, opening doors for people with diverse skills, ambitions, and backgrounds.
  
  
We help organisations find the skills and solutions to reach their goals and assist talented professionals to power their unique potential.
  
  
We offer our people incredible career opportunities as well as an inclusive culture and flexible working
  
  
**Function**
The Team Leader is responsible for leading the day-to-day delivery of US recruitment support operations across Onboarding Coordination, Recruitment Coordination, and Green Card functions. This role will oversee team performance, workload distribution, service quality, and adherence to contractual KPIs, governance requirements, and RWO standards.
  
  
The Team Leader will ensure consistent service delivery, strong accountability, and operational discipline across the US shift. This includes independently managing escalations, supporting capacity planning, identifying performance or quality concerns, and partnering with the Account Manager where additional guidance or escalation is required.
  
  
This role will also serve as the primary point of contact for team process questions, support new hire onboarding and refresher training, and drive continuous improvement across all supported functions to streamline processes, strengthen controls, and enhance the overall employee, candidate, and stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a US region-focused recruitment support team across Onboarding Coordination,Recruitment Coordination, and Green Card functions, ensuring high-quality service delivery and achievement of contractual KPIs.
* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management for the team, fostering accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor team performance against contractual KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, and governance requirements, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Uphold RWO standards across the US shift, ensuring consistent attendance, availability, productivity, and adherence to expected working practices, including appropriate break management.
* Oversee workload distribution, ensuring work is allocated effectively across the team and aligned to business priorities, capacity, and service expectations.
* Support capacity planning by monitoring team volumes, workload trends, coverage gaps, and individual capability, using insights to inform team development discussions.
* Act as the primary point of contact for team process questions, providing guidance and escalating to the Account Manager where required.
* Independently manage operational escalations, resolving issues in a timely and professional manner while partnering with the Account Manager for complex, sensitive, or high-risk matters.
* Identify and escalate performance, quality, compliance, or capacity concerns to the Account Manager, ensuring risks are addressed quickly and appropriately.
* Ensure consistent execution of recruitment coordination, onboarding, and Green Card processes in line with client expectations, governance requirements, and documented procedures.
* Conduct regular quality reviews, audits, and spot checks of team outputs to ensure accuracy, compliance, and adherence to established processes.
* Coordinate onboarding for new team members, including role-based training, process orientation, system guidance, and readiness support
* Deliver refresher training as needed to reinforce process expectations, address recurring quality themes, and support team capability development.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvement within assigned functions, proactively identifying opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve the overall service experience.
* Support the implementation of process changes, technology enhancements, and best practices across the US recruitment support functions.
* Produce and share operational updates, performance insights, and workload reporting to support service governance and management visibility.
* Partner closely with Recruitment Partners, Account Management, Service Delivery stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure seamless delivery across all supported US functions.
* Support ad hoc projects, initiatives, and operational priorities as required, contributing leadership, process knowledge, and execution support.
* Promote cross-training, knowledge sharing, and team resilience to support business continuity and consistent service delivery.

**Skills And Experience**

* Extensive people management experience, including direct responsibility for teams of 5+ employees.
* Previous experience leading recruitment operations, recruitment coordination, onboarding coordination, shared services, RPO, or related operational teams.
* Experience managing service delivery across contractual KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, and governance requirements.
* Strong understanding of recruitment lifecycle operations, including coordination, onboarding, compliance, and process-controlled service delivery.
* Proven ability to manage team performance, address quality concerns, support development discussions, and drive accountability.
* Strong escalation management skills, with the ability to resolve operational issues independently and identify when to engage senior stakeholders.
* Experience monitoring workloads, distributing work, supporting capacity planning, and identifying coverage or resourcing risks.
* Strong process governance mindset, with the ability to ensure consistent adherence to standards, procedures, and expected ways of working.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement, streamline processes, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, organisational, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to support US working hours and hold the US shift accountable to expected service, availability, and productivity standards.
* Proficiency with ATS/recruitment systems, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and operational trackers

**Desirable**

* Experience supporting recruitment operations across US markets.
* Knowledge of recruitment compliance and onboarding processes.
* Experience driving process improvement initiatives within a service delivery environment.

**Benefits**

* A unique opportunity to drive projects such as Employer Branding, Talent pipelining, Recruitment Innovation, Candidate Experience
* A track record of high performance and an ability to deliver excellent results consistently is key. In return for your hard work, you'll be offered a competitive top salary and benefits package with bonuses/commission and fantastic incentives programme
* Private medical insurance
* A fantastic training and development programme
* Volunteer time off
* The opportunity to partake / qualify for our Global incentive weekend
* Employee wellbeing through various programmes
* You'll have plenty of opportunities to progress your career, both in your country and other locations around the world. That's the benefit of working for a large global organisation. One that is at the forefront of recruitment innovation, and a specialist in RPO and MSP

If you require any accommodations or adjustments as a result of a disability, impairment or health condition, please do not hesitate to let me know.*

description:

This position requires deep knowledge of India benefits, experience managing benefits in a multi-country environment, and the ability to work effectively with local leadership, global teams, brokers, vendors, and People Group partners. This role will also lead a small benefits team of approximately 2 to 3 team members, providing day-to-day guidance, coaching, workload management, and support to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent execution of benefits processes.

**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**

* Lead, coach, and support a small benefits team responsible for benefits administration and operations across assigned countries.

* Build strong working relationships with local leadership, People Group partners, brokers, vendors, and global benefits stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted benefits subject matter expert for assigned countries, with particular emphasis on India benefits.
* Support clear benefits communication, education, and change management for team members and local People Group teams.
* Develop team capability by providing guidance, feedback, training, and process clarity.

**Client**

* Serve as the primary benefits lead for assigned countries, initially focused on India and the Philippines.
* Manage benefits inquiries, escalations, issue resolution, renewals, vendor coordination, and employee-facing benefits support.
* Partner with local leadership and People Group teams to provide practical benefits guidance that balances compliance, market practice, cost, and team member experience.
* Work with brokers and vendors to ensure service levels, claims support, renewal execution, and team member experience expectations are met.
* Support enrollment activity, benefits communications, employee education sessions, and related materials.
* Ensure benefits processes are clear, well-documented, and aligned with Ryan’s service expectations.

**Value**

* Lead the administration, renewal, and governance of benefits programs across assigned countries.
* Bring deep expertise in India benefits, including insured benefits, statutory requirements, broker and carrier management, renewal cycles, claims escalation, compliance, and employee communications.
* Support benefits activity for additional countries as Ryan’s global benefits operating model evolves.
* Identify opportunities to streamline benefits administration, reduce manual work, improve controls, and create more consistent processes across geographies.
* Partner with global benefits leadership to support benefit program decisions, vendor management, renewals, benchmarking, and cost analysis.
* Review plan documents, insurance policies, benefit guides, enrollment materials, and vendor communications for accuracy and alignment with local requirements.
* Support benefits due diligence and integration activities for mergers, acquisitions, and international expansion.
* Maintain appropriate benefit records, vendor files, renewal materials, process documentation, and audit controls.
* Monitor vendor performance, team member feedback, utilization trends, and operational issues to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Support global benefits projects as assigned, particularly where operational coordination, reporting, vendor follow-up, or cross-country execution is required.

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

* Experience supporting benefits across multiple countries, particularly in Asia Pacific, the GCC, or a global corporate environment, strongly preferred.

* Experience working with global teams, regional stakeholders, local leadership, brokers, vendors, and corporate centers of excellence required.
* Experience with mergers and acquisitions, benefits integration, vendor transitions, process improvement, governance, or shared services/operations models preferred.

* Standard indoor working environment.

description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Human Resources
  
  
Our HR Team are the force for good that bring Reckitt's ambition to life. We work together to ensure the delivery of sustained profitable growth by unleashing the power of our purpose, people and performance. Now is an exciting time to be part of shaping the future of HR, influencing an exciting global organisation, while developing business and functional leadership skills, all at the same time. Whatever your role in our HR community, you'll take ownership of your projects and workstreams. We focus on developing our leaders to spearhead our culture and growth, so you'll be supported and mentored to deliver the right plans to drive business performance - and we'll celebrate the results with you along the way.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Reckitt, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. As a Payroll & Benefits Senior Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of accurate, compliant, and employee-centric payroll services while supporting a complex and dynamic international environment.
  
  
This role goes beyond transactional payroll processing. You will serve as a trusted payroll expert, driving operational excellence, risk mitigation, compliance, and continuous improvement across your designated markets. You will work closely with HR, Finance, Tax, external payroll providers, and business stakeholders to ensure payroll operations are executed to the highest standard.
  
  
Given our current strategic priorities, we are particularly interested in professionals with strong Dutch payroll expertise, including experience navigating complex tax, social security, and equity-related payroll matters.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Payroll Operations & Compliance:
* Own and oversee end-to-end payroll activities for your assigned market(s), ensuring payroll is processed accurately, compliantly, and on schedule.
* Partner closely with local stakeholders, payroll vendors, HR teams, and Finance to ensure seamless payroll service delivery.
* Perform detailed payroll validation and variance analysis, identifying, investigating, and resolving discrepancies to maintain the highest levels of payroll accuracy.
* Ensure all payroll activities are fully compliant with local legislation, tax regulations, social security requirements, and internal governance standards.
* Prepare, review, and approve payroll outputs, reports, reconciliations, and related documentation.
* Subject Matter Expertise:
* Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on payroll, taxation, social security, and benefits-related matters.
* Provide guidance on complex payroll scenarios, including: 30% ruling administration, Cross-entity payroll arrangements, Tax year corrections and retroactive adjustments, Social security implications, Equity compensation programs, International assignments and mobility-related payroll matters
* Support the resolution of complex employee and stakeholder queries.
* Statutory & Benefits Administration:
* Ensure the accurate administration and reporting of payroll taxes, statutory deductions, social security contributions, and other regulatory obligations.
* Manage company benefits and related payroll components, including insurance premiums, pensions, sick pay, and other employee entitlements.
* Coordinate the submission of statutory filings and maintain complete audit-ready documentation.
* Oversee payroll calendars and payment schedules to ensure timely execution of employee and third-party payments.
* Stakeholder Management:
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external payroll providers, government authorities, auditors, and other key stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with HR, Reward, Tax, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure alignment on payroll-related matters.
* Support internal and external audits by providing payroll expertise, documentation, and remediation actions where required.
* Continuous Improvement & Transformation:
* Contribute to payroll transformation projects, including system implementations, integrations, and process redesign initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen governance, and enhance the employee experience.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Recognized Dutch payroll qualification (PDL, VPS and/or NIRPA registration preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Dutch payroll, wage tax, social security, payroll compliance, 30% ruling, tax year corrections, and cross-entity payroll.
* Fluent in English, with Dutch language skills considered a strong advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, HR, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of payroll experience, including end-to-end payroll ownership.
* Experience working with payroll providers such as ADP, Strada, or similar.
* Proven experience in multinational payroll environments.
* Proficiency in HRIS/payroll systems (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday) and advanced Excel skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Customer-focused, detail-oriented, and highly organized.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.

The skills for success
  
  
Diversity and inclusion, Data and Analytics, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Organisational structure, Coaching skills; Facilitation skills, Change management, Execute plans, Strategic mindset, Employment engagement, Digital literacy, Commercial accumen, Courageous leadership.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Product Manager - HR Technology
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Product Manager - HR Technology****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Product Manager | Enterprise SaaS - B2B | Hyderabad | Hybrid**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone powers the future of workforce readiness. Our platform helps organizations understand the skills they have, the skills they need, and the fastest path between the two — combining learning, talent development, and workforce intelligence in one system.
  
  
We serve approximately 7,000 organizations and more than 140 million users across 186 countries, backed by two decades of workforce data and a skills taxonomy spanning 55,000+ skills. Our India teams in Pune and Bengaluru are core product and engineering centers, not support satellites — the work you own here ships to global enterprise customers.
  
  
**The role in one paragraph**
You will own a product area end to end: the problems it solves, the roadmap that gets there, and the outcomes it produces. You'll work daily with engineering squads, a designer, and stakeholders across sales, customer success, and support. This is a builder's role — we expect you to form your own point of view on what to build, defend it with evidence, and be accountable for whether it worked
  
  
**In This Role You Will**
Own a problem space, not a feature list
  
  
Develop deep understanding of your area — the users, the jobs they're trying to get done, the workflows around your product, and where the current experience breaks down.
  
  
Maintain a prioritized roadmap tied to explicit business and customer outcomes, and be able to explain the reasoning behind any item on it — including what you chose not to build.
  
  
Write clear PRDs and requirements: problem, user, success criteria, scope boundaries, edge cases, etc.
  
  
Ship with your squad
  
  
Partner with engineering and design from problem framing through release — refinement, trade-off calls, scope decisions, and unblocking during the sprint.
  
  
Break large initiatives into releasable increments so customers see value early and often.
  
  
Own launch readiness: enablement content, release notes, support handoff, and rollout plan.
  
  
Work from evidence
  
  
Talk to customers regularly — discovery calls, feedback sessions, and reviewing real usage in the product.
  
  
Define the instrumentation and success metrics for what you ship, then go back and check whether the metrics moved.
  
  
Manage stakeholders across regions
  
  
Represent your area to sales, customer success, support, and leadership; translate customer escalations and field requests into product signal without letting the loudest voice set the roadmap.
  
  
Work effectively across time zones with counterparts in the US and EMEA..
  
  
**You Have Got What It Take If You Have**
2–4 years in product management, including at least 2 years owning a product area for a B2B or enterprise SaaS product.
  
  
A track record of features you shipped and can speak to concretely: what problem it solved, what you decided and why, what the outcome was, and what you'd do differently.
  
  
Strong written communication. You can write a PRD an engineer can build from and a one-pager an executive can decide from.
  
  
Comfort with data — you can pull and interpret product analytics, define events worth tracking, and reason about a funnel without waiting for someone else to build the dashboard.
  
  
Experience working directly with engineering in an agile environment, including making scope trade-offs under real deadlines.
  
  
Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.
  
  
**Nice to have**
Domain background in HR tech, learning management, talent development, recruiting, or workforce planning.
  
  
Experience with AI/ML-driven product features — recommendations, matching, search relevance, or agent-based workflows — including how to evaluate quality and handle failure modes.
  
  
Experience shipping localized products or working with globally distributed engineering teams.
  
  
Exposure to enterprise sales cycles, RFPs, or public-sector customers
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million+ users in 180+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high-performing, future-ready organizations and people today.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

title: HR Executive – Recruitment, HR Operations & Compliance
description:
HR Executive – Recruitment, HR Operations & Compliance

**Company:**
 PlantsShip

**Location:**
 Hyderabad, Telangana

**Department:**
 Human Resources

**Employment Type:**
 Full-time

**Experience:**
 5–8+ years

**Reporting To:**
 Management / Business Head

**Salary:**
 Negotiable based on experience and capability

1. About PlantsShip

PlantsShip is a growing landscaping, irrigation, nursery production and exports company, delivering landscaping development, horticulture, hardscaping, irrigation, plant supply and maintenance services.

Our vision is to build a ₹1,000 crore company by 2030 while expanding our business across India and international markets.

We are looking for a proactive, experienced HR professional who can establish a structured HR function, take complete ownership of recruitment and ensure smooth HR operations across our business.

2. Role Objective

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, with primary ownership of 
**end-to-end recruitment, manpower planning, HR operations, payroll coordination, statutory compliance and performance management**
.

The candidate must be capable of working independently with management and department heads to ensure that the right people are recruited, onboarded and retained to support the company's growth.

3. Key Responsibilities

**A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition – Primary Responsibility**

* Take complete ownership of recruitment across all departments.
* Collect manpower requirements from management and department heads.
* Prepare and maintain Job Descriptions (JDs) and candidate competency profiles.
* Develop recruitment plans, hiring timelines and sourcing strategies.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, employee referrals, recruitment agencies and other channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Assess candidates for experience, skills, salary expectations, communication and suitability.
* Coordinate technical and functional interviews with department heads.
* Maintain interview evaluation forms, candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Manage salary discussions, notice periods and joining commitments within approved limits.
* Submit shortlisted candidates and hiring recommendations to management for approval.
* Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, documentation and joining formalities.
* Track recruitment KPIs, including time-to-hire, hiring cost, offer acceptance and joining ratio.
* Build a talent pipeline for critical roles across Sales, Operations, Finance, Procurement, Project Management, Nursery and other departments.

**B. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage employee onboarding, induction, probation, confirmation, transfers and exit formalities.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, relieving letters and experience letters.
* Maintain employee files, HR records, attendance, leave records and employee databases.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the Accounts/Finance team.
* Address employee queries related to salary, attendance, leave, policies and documentation.
* Establish and implement HR policies, employee handbooks, rules and procedures.
* Manage employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace issues.
* Maintain employee headcount and department-wise manpower records.

**C. Statutory Compliance & Documentation**

* Coordinate applicable PF, ESI, Professional Tax, gratuity, labour-law and other employment-related compliance requirements.
* Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely completion of applicable filings and payments.
* Coordinate with payroll teams, external consultants, auditors and relevant authorities.
* Monitor employment documentation and statutory records.
* Identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance requirements are reviewed according to applicable laws and establishment-specific obligations.

**D. Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Establish KRAs, KPIs and performance appraisal processes in consultation with management.
* Coordinate probation reviews and employee performance evaluations.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Support departmental manpower planning and organization structure development.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity and retention.
* Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

**E. HR Systems, SOPs & Reporting**

* Develop HR SOPs, formats, checklists and approval workflows.
* Implement and maintain an HRMS or structured employee database.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS and management dashboards.
* Maintain recruitment, headcount, attendance, attrition and payroll reports.
* Establish clear HR processes, responsibilities and accountability.
* Conduct periodic internal HR reviews and recommend improvements.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The HR Manager will be evaluated on:

1. Recruitment fulfilment against approved manpower requirements.
2. Time taken to fill vacancies.
3. Quality and suitability of shortlisted candidates.
4. Offer acceptance and joining ratios.
5. Recruitment cost and sourcing effectiveness.
6. Completion of employee documentation and onboarding.
7. Payroll coordination accuracy and timeliness.
8. Timely completion of applicable statutory compliance activities.
9. Completion of probation and performance reviews.
10. Accuracy of HR MIS and employee records.
11. Employee retention and resolution of HR queries.
12. Implementation of HR policies, SOPs and systems.

5. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* 5–8+ years of hands-on HR experience.
* Proven experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, employee lifecycle and payroll coordination.
* Practical understanding of Indian labour laws and applicable statutory compliance.
* Experience preparing HR policies, employment letters, SOPs and HR reports.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and HRMS/payroll systems.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple departments.

6. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Landscaping and horticulture
* Construction and infrastructure
* Real estate and project execution
* Nursery, agriculture and agri-business
* Manufacturing or other multi-department operational businesses

Experience recruiting sales professionals, project managers, engineers, supervisors, finance professionals and operational staff will be an advantage.

7. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Proactive, organised and accountable.
* Strong in execution, not limited to administrative work.
* Comfortable managing multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Capable of building recruitment systems and maintaining a strong candidate pipeline.
* Confident in coordinating with senior management and department heads.
* Focused on measurable outcomes, process discipline and compliance.
* Interested in growing with a company that has ambitious expansion plans.

8. Reporting & Decision-Making Authority

The HR Manager will manage the recruitment process and HR operations independently within approved policies and budgets.

* Department heads will identify manpower requirements and evaluate technical suitability.
* HR will manage sourcing, screening, interview coordination and recruitment documentation.
* Management will approve final hiring decisions, salary exceptions and other key employment decisions.
* HR will coordinate offer release, onboarding and employee documentation after approval.

9. Application Process

Interested candidates should apply with their updated resume and include:

* Total HR experience.
* Years of hands-on recruitment experience.
* Industries and positions recruited for.
* Experience managing payroll and statutory compliance.
* Current CTC and expected CTC.
* Notice period and availability to join.

**Join PlantsShip and help build a strong HR function to support our growth towards our ₹1,000 crore vision for 2030.**

title: HR Risk & Compliance Manager
description:
HR Operations- Risk & Compliance Manager
  
  
This role is open in multiple locations and benefits vary based on the location of hire.
  
  
**About Flutter Entertainment**
Flutter Entertainment is the
**world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator**
with
**15.9 million**
Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of
**$16.4 billion**
in 2025. We have a
**portfolio of iconic brands**
, including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.
  
  
Flutter Entertainment is listed on the
**New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).**
We’re proud to be recognized by
**TIME**
as one of the
**World’s Best Companies 2025**
— a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  
  
Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing
**portfolio of brands**
across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
The HR Risk & Compliance Manager is a pivotal mid-level leadership role within Flutter's Group HR Operations & Transformation department, serving as a trusted strategic partner to HR leadership and the broader executive team.
  
  
As Flutter continues to scale its global footprint, this role provides the essential oversight and subject matter expertise required to navigate an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory landscape — translating legal and compliance obligations into practical, operationally sound HR practices that protect both the organization and its employees.
  
  
At its core, the HR Risk & Compliance Manager is responsible for ongoing, recording and managing risk registers, Controls, Issues, actions on Flutter Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tool for Group HR Operations & Transformation.
  
  
This encompasses the full lifecycle of compliance activity — from horizon-scanning for emerging regulatory changes and conduct structured risk assessments, through to designing and embedding policies, procedures, and controls that align with global employment law standards, data protection obligations, and Flutter's defined organizational risk appetite.
  
  
The role requires a practitioner who can operate with equal confidence at a strategic level — advising senior stakeholders on risk exposure and compliance posture — and at a detailed operational level, ensuring that day-to-day HR processes consistently meet their regulatory and ethical obligations.
  
  
A central pillar of this role is deep subject matter expertise across multi-jurisdictional employment law and data privacy regulation.
  
  
**Accountabilities & Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance**

* Monitor and ensure ongoing adherence to employment legislation across all jurisdictions in which the organization operates.
* Proactively assess regulatory changes — including amendments to wage and hour laws, termination requirements, leave entitlements, and worker classification rules — and translate these into actionable policy updates and operational guidance within required implementation timelines.
* Provide authoritative, risk-informed guidance to HR Business Partners, People Leaders, and senior management on complex employment matters
* Serve as the primary internal subject matter expert on employment standards, maintaining a current and comprehensive register of statutory obligations across all active jurisdictions and flagging emerging regulatory risks to senior management.

GRC Record Maintenance
  
  

* Design, implement, and continuously maintain a comprehensive HR Governance, Risk, and Compliance framework that aligns with recognised standards
* Establish, document, and record internal controls including sox controls covering the full employee lifecycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management, data handling, and offboarding — ensuring each control is mapped to its underlying regulatory obligation.
* Maintain a live GRC register that captures all applicable regulatory requirements, assigned control owners, control testing schedules, and remediation actions, providing leadership with a transparent and auditable view of the organisation's HR compliance status at any given time.
* Ensure that compliance requirements are clearly communicated across the organisation and that accountabilities for policy adherence are embedded within role descriptions, manager onboarding materials, and departmental operating procedures.

**Risk Assessment & Mitigation**

* Conduct structured, periodic HR process risk assessments across all HR operations & Transformation processes and geographies, utilising both qualitative and quantitative methodologies to identify compliance gaps, operational vulnerabilities, and areas of elevated legal exposure.
* Develop and execute targeted risk mitigation strategies for identified findings, assigning clear ownership, remediation timelines, and success metrics; monitor progress against agreed action plans and escalate unresolved or high-severity risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Prepare clear, concise risk reports and compliance dashboards for presentation to senior leadership, the HR Director, and board-level oversight committees, translating technical compliance findings into business-relevant risk language that supports informed decision-making.
* Maintain a dynamic HR risk register that is reviewed and updated on a defined cadence (at minimum quarterly), incorporating changes in the regulatory environment, organisational structure, workforce composition, and operational footprint.
* Conduct Risk & Control self-assessment (RCSA) for all Group HR operation & Transformation processes

Compliance Auditing & Monitoring
  
  

* Plan and execute a structured programme of internal HR compliance reviews covering key risk areas including right-to-work verification, payroll compliance etc.
* Develop audit methodologies, sampling frameworks, and test scripts appropriate to each audit area; document findings in formal audit reports that clearly articulate the nature of any non-compliance, the associated risk level, and recommended corrective actions with defined remediation timelines.
* Implement a continuous compliance monitoring programme — distinct from periodic auditing — that provides real-time or near-real-time visibility into key compliance indicators, such as training completion rates, policy acknowledgement status, and the timeliness of disciplinary process documentation.
* Track and report on the status of all corrective actions arising from internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and self-identified compliance gaps, ensuring that remediation is completed within agreed timeframes and that repeat findings are escalated appropriately.

**Regulatory Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain a comprehensive and well-organised compliance documentation repository, ensuring that all policies, audit records, risk assessments, training logs, regulatory correspondence, and incident reports are retained in accordance with applicable data retention requirements and are readily accessible for regulatory inspection or internal review.
* Develop and maintain a regulatory reporting calendar that captures all recurring submission deadlines across jurisdictions, with sufficient lead time built in for data collection, validation, and sign-off by relevant stakeholders.

Training & Awareness Programs
  
  

* Design and deliver a comprehensive HR compliance training curriculum for three distinct audiences: HR professionals requiring in-depth knowledge of compliance obligations and processes; people managers requiring practical guidance on legally compliant decision-making; and all employees requiring foundational awareness of key compliance topics.
* Develop engaging, jurisdiction-appropriate training content covering priority compliance areas including GDPR and data protection obligations, anti-discrimination and equal opportunity requirements, anti-harassment and respectful workplace standards, whistleblowing procedures, and applicable health and safety responsibilities — leveraging a blend of e-learning modules, live workshops, and written guidance materials.
* Establish a training tracking and reporting mechanism that monitors completion rates by business unit, role level, and geography; identify and follow up on gaps in completion; and produce regular training compliance reports for HR leadership that demonstrate the organisation's investment in a culture of compliance.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through post-training assessments, employee surveys, and trend analysis of compliance incidents and policy breaches, using insights to continuously improve content, delivery methods, and targeting of awareness campaigns.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the HR function's primary compliance liaison to Legal, Finance, IT, Data Privacy, Internal Audit, and operational business units, ensuring that HR compliance considerations are embedded into organisational processes, system implementations, and strategic initiatives from the outset rather than as an afterthought.
* Support merger, acquisition, and corporate restructuring activities by leading HR compliance due diligence workstreams — assessing the target organisation's employment law compliance status, workforce liabilities, policy frameworks, and data protection practices — and providing structured findings and risk assessments to the deal team and senior leadership.
* Coordinate with external legal advisors, specialist employment counsel, data protection consultants, and HR compliance specialists as required, managing these relationships effectively to ensure timely, cost-efficient, and high-quality advice that is appropriately integrated into internal compliance processes.
* Champion a cross-functional approach to compliance culture, proactively identifying opportunities to align HR compliance initiatives with broader organisational governance programmes and contributing to enterprise-wide risk and compliance forums, committees, and reporting processes.

**Skills & Capabilities**
Success in this role requires a well-rounded combination of technical expertise, analytical capability, and interpersonal effectiveness. The ideal candidate will bring both the specialist knowledge to navigate complex regulatory environments and the professional maturity to influence organizational behavior at all levels.
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* The role requires a deep and current understanding of employment law and HR regulations across multiple jurisdictions, including familiarity with region-specific frameworks such as the EU's Working Time Directive, the UK Employment Rights Act, the US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), and equivalent standards in other applicable geographies.
* A strong command of data protection legislation is essential, particularly the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and its national implementations, as well as comparable privacy frameworks such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other local privacy laws that intersect with HR data processing activities.
* The role further demands hands-on familiarity with GRC methodologies — including risk registers, control frameworks, and compliance lifecycle management — alongside practical experience operating HR information systems (HRIS) and dedicated compliance management platforms such as Workday.

**Risk Management & Analytical Thinking**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven capability to identify, assess, and prioritize compliance risks across the full spectrum of HR operations — from recruitment and onboarding through to termination and post-employment obligations
* The Candidate should have the ability to conduct structured risk assessments, develop evidence-based mitigation strategies, and monitor the effectiveness of controls over time.
* The Candidate should have the ability to translate dense and often ambiguous regulatory requirements into clear, practical, and operationally viable solutions — bridging the gap between legal obligation and day-to-day HR practice without creating unnecessary organizational friction.
* Handle SOX & Audit sessions as a bridge between HR operations & Audit teams.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are a non-negotiable requirement.
* The HR Risk & Compliance Manager will regularly engage with a diverse range of audiences — from senior executives and legal counsel to frontline managers and individual employees — and must be able to calibrate the complexity and tone of compliance guidance accordingly.
* This includes the ability to produce clear policy documents, concise audit reports, and compelling training materials, as well as the confidence to present risk findings and recommendations to leadership.
* Strong relationship-building capabilities will be essential in fostering a culture of compliance across geographically dispersed teams.

**Project Management & Organizational Effectiveness**

* The breadth of this role demands exceptional organizational discipline and the ability to manage multiple concurrent compliance workstreams without compromising quality or accuracy.
* The successful candidate will be comfortable owning initiatives from scoping through to completion, setting clear milestones, managing dependencies, and proactively escalating blockers when necessary.
* A high degree of attention to detail is critical — particularly when exploring policy documentation, interpreting regulatory guidance, or preparing materials for external regulatory bodies.
* The ability to work with a significant degree of autonomy, demonstrating self-direction and initiative while maintaining appropriate visibility with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners throughout each project lifecycle.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**
**Required Experience**
Candidates must bring a minimum of 7–8 years of progressive experience in HR compliance, employment law, governance, or a closely related risk management function.
  
  
This experience should demonstrate a consistent track record of managing compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously — not merely exposure to a single domestic market.
  
  
Applicants should be able to evidence hands-on involvement in developing and implementing compliance frameworks from the ground up or substantially overhaul existing structures to meet evolving regulatory demands.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
A bachelor’s degree in human resources, Law, Business Administration, or a closely related discipline is required as a foundational academic qualification.
  
  
In addition, candidates must hold either a recognised professional HR qualification — such as CIPD, SHRM CP/SHRM-SCP, or a nationally recognised equivalent — or a legal qualification,
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Prior experience within multinational or global organisations — particularly those navigating complex, multi-layered regulatory environments — is highly desirable, as is a professional background in regulated industries such as financial services, gaming, fintech, or healthcare, where compliance culture is embedded and rigorously enforced.
  
  
Candidates with meaningful exposure to data protection and privacy compliance, including practical application of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or equivalent frameworks such as the CCPA, will hold a distinct advantage given the intersection of HR data handling and privacy obligations in this role.
  
  
Experience conducting or supporting compliance audits, internal controls reviews, or regulatory inspections is also preferred, as is familiarity with compliance management software platforms such as Archer, Audit board technology solutions that streamline monitoring and reporting workflows.
  
  
**Measure of Success**

* Establishing of the GRC hierarchy, Risk management framework implementation across HR operations & transformation
* Number of process deep dive completion , Self-Identified issues & Control Monitoring

**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs.
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year.
* Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness.
* Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.
* Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance.
* Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance.
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.
* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards.

**WHY CHOOSE US**
Flutter is an
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.
  
  
We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.
  
  
If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

**Job Title**
**Principal Analyst – Taleo Application (IT Enterprise Solutions)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands\-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. This role requires a seasoned professional who can independently manage integrations with HRMS/ERP systems, background check providers, job boards, and career sites, while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and external vendors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
***End\-to\-End Recruitment Process \& Taleo Application Ownership***
* Own and drive functional and technical ownership of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform across all modules, including Taleo Recruiting (OTAC), Onboarding, Career Sections (internal and external), and Taleo Connect Client (TCC).
* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of the complete recruitment lifecycle – requisition creation and approval, sourcing, candidate screening, interview scheduling, offer management, background verification, and onboarding – and translate this knowledge into effective Taleo configurations.
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and rollout of new Taleo features, workflows, and enhancements aligned to evolving recruitment and business needs.
* Provide advanced production support and root\-cause troubleshooting for issues related to requisitions, workflows, offers, career sites, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and release cycles, ensuring minimal disruption to live recruitment operations.


***Taleo Connect Client (TCC) \& Integrations***
* Serve as the hands\-on subject matter expert for Taleo Connect Client (TCC), independently building, testing, scheduling, and troubleshooting inbound/outbound data integrations and exports/imports.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and HRMS/ERP systems, including Oracle ERP/HCM, ensuring seamless data flow for candidate, requisition, and employee records.
* Own integrations with background check providers, job boards/aggregators, and career site platforms, ensuring accurate posting, sourcing, and candidate data exchange.
* Work with XML, CSV, flat\-file structures, web services, and APIs to support integration development, monitoring, and error resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all integration touchpoints in line with organizational and regulatory requirements.


***Implementation \& Project Delivery***
* Independently manage and execute Taleo ATS implementations end\-to\-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Prepare functional and technical specification documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and cutover/rollout plans.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go\-live readiness.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to optimize recruitment workflows, system performance, and user experience.


***Stakeholder \& Vendor Management***
* Act as the primary liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, IT, and business leadership to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Taleo solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across geographies, managing expectations, timelines, and priorities effectively.
* Manage relationships with Oracle Taleo support, implementation partners, background check vendors, and job board/career site providers, including contract deliverables, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non\-technical audiences, through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates to stakeholders and leadership.


***Reporting, Compliance \& Mentoring***
* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards to support recruiting metrics, compliance reporting, and executive insights.
* Ensure recruitment processes and system configurations align with applicable compliance requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and internal audit/SOX controls where applicable).
* Provide technical and functional guidance to junior analysts and HR systems team members, and contribute to knowledge transfer, training, and documentation.


**Required Qualifications**
***Experience***
* 8–12\+ years of overall IT/HR systems experience, with a significant portion focused on Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven track record of having managed and executed at least one full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementation, in addition to multiple enhancement and support engagements.
* Mandatory hands\-on expertise with Taleo Connect Client (TCC), including building and troubleshooting integrations independently.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Taleo with HRMS/ERP platforms (e.g., Oracle ERP/HCM), background check providers, job boards, and career sites.


***Technical \& Functional Skills***
* Strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment process and how it maps to Taleo Recruiting, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* In\-depth, hands\-on knowledge of Taleo application features and functions across Recruiting, Onboarding, and Career Sections.
* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capability within the Taleo platform.


***Soft Skills***
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross\-functional and cross\-geography teams.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience, including managing SLAs, escalations, and deliverables with external partners.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle Taleo certification(s).
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or Oracle ERP integrations.
* Exposure to global recruiting processes and compliance requirements (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP).
* Prior experience in large enterprise or global HR/IT environments.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**What You Can Expect**
* Supportive of your career and professional development
* An inclusive culture and community\-minded organization where giving back is encouraged
* A global team of curious lifelong learners guided by our company values

description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
   

  

 We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
   

  

 Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities.
   

  

 Head of HR Services India will lead all HR Services activities for the Service Delivery Unit (SDU) in India, strategic and operational HR services owning delivery of transactional, strategic and platform\-based HR services (HR operations, HRIS, payroll interfaces, service management, case resolution, and vendor management). This role combines strategic leadership, operational HR management, process optimization, and people leadership to enable data\-driven decisions and alignment with global HR standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Service delivery leadership
+ Own end\-to\-end HR Services delivery for the SDU
+ Ensure consistent, high\-quality service through defined SLAs, KPIs, and service\-level reporting.

* Operations \& process excellence

+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives (automation, RPA, workflow redesign) to increase efficiency, reduce error rates, and shorten turnaround times.
+ Manage capacity planning, workload balancing, and operational resilience for peak cycles (e.g., payroll, year\-end processes).

* HRIS \& technology stewardship
+ Champion adoption of HR technology, self\-service portals, and automation to improve employee and manager experience.
+ Oversee reporting and analytics for service performance, data quality, and business insights.

* Vendor \& partner management
+ Manage relationships with external service providers (payroll vendors, benefits administrators, IT vendors, recruitment shared services) and ensure contractual SLAs are met.

+ Use metrics to drive improvement plans and communicate performance trends and risks.

* Change \& transition management
+ Lead service transition projects (new processes, vendor transitions, system rollouts) and ensure minimal disruption to operations.
+ Support global HR transformation programs by providing delivery expertise, implementation planning, and stakeholder coordination.

* Team leadership \& capability building
+ Build, lead, and retain a high\-performing HR Services team focused on operational excellence and customer service.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Strong knowledge of HR service management best practices, process automation tools (RPA), and service reporting/analytics.

title: HR Partner - Oakridge International School - Gachibowli
description:
Oakridge Gachibowli is a premium international day school in India. We have the proud privilege of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. We have 150\+ IB\-trained teachers with years of experience, helping us consistently achieve outstanding results and seeing our students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is a leading premium day school in India, with more than 2800 students in full time enrollment. The school has a proud legacy of 22 years educational excellence and of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. The school has 150\+ IB\-trained teachers, enabling consistent outstanding results and inspire students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. The school serves Nursery through to high school (Grade 12\) students. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 The Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is partnered with the Nord Anglia Education family, the world’s leading premium international school organisation. They currently have 81 schools in India, China, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and North, Central and South America. NAE are a fast growing, successful education company with over 50 years’ experience. The schools are amongst the most respected premium schools in their markets and are a very popular choice for parents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic role responsible for aligning HR practices with the school’s goals and educational mission. Acting as a trusted advisor to school leadership and faculty, the HRBP supports workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance development, and change management. The role ensures that HR initiatives promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing school culture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic HR Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with school leadership to understand staffing needs and workforce planning.Align HR strategies with academic and operational goals.Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 
 Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and lead recruitment for teaching, administrative, and support staff.Ensure timely onboarding and orientation of new hires.Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring practices.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement:** 
 Foster a positive work environment through proactive engagement and support.Handle employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution in a fair and consistent manner.Develop and implement initiatives that support staff well\-being and retention.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Development:** 
 Support performance appraisal processes and goal\-setting practices.Collaborate with department heads to identify professional development needs.Guide leadership and staff on career development opportunities and succession planning.
   

  

**Compliance \& Policy Implementation:** 
 Ensure compliance with labor laws, school policies, and relevant educational regulations.Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date HR documentation and records.Lead internal audits and HR reporting as needed.
   

  

 Detailed JD : JD \- HR Partner \- OIS.pdf
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 The India People team is establishing the people practices and employee experience that will support the launch and growth of our Hyderabad site. We partner closely with site leaders and employees to create effective teams, consistent leadership practices, and a healthy, sustainable workplace as the operation scales.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As the India People Business Partner, you will be a highly visible, hands\-on presence at the Hyderabad site, staying close to daily operations, leaders, and employees throughout the site's launch, growth, and stabilization. You will support employee engagement, manager effectiveness, organizational effectiveness, talent management, employee relations, workforce planning, and change management. You will coordinate two Human Resources Generalists and use people data to identify risks, improve day\-to\-day execution, and help shape the site's future people practices. You will report to the People Director on our EE People Ops \- HR Business Partner HRBP team in our HR organization.

* Support team design, workforce planning, succession planning, talent cycles, and role clarity while identifying opportunities to improve the site's organizational effectiveness.
* Manage sensitive employee relations matters, support investigations and escalations, and promote consistent application of company policies and local labor requirements.
* Coordinate and prioritize the work of two Human Resources Generalists while partnering with the Senior Manager or Director on organizational decisions, talent priorities, escalations, and site\-level people risks.


**We're excited about you because…**
* You have 6\+ years of progressive experience in a People Business Partner, Human Resources Business Partner, or comparable role supporting business leaders and employees.
* You have experience providing hands\-on people support in a high\-growth, site\-based, operations\-focused, or multi\-shift environment.
* You have applied knowledge of employee relations, sensitive investigations, policy administration, and employment compliance in India.
* You have experience coaching managers and supporting organizational effectiveness, succession planning, talent processes, workforce planning, employee engagement, and organizational change.

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. Lead offer construction and closure for senior hires, with awareness of US compensation norms where relevant. Manage recruiting capacity including agency relationships.
 



  





**Compensation and equity** 




 Run the compensation cycle end to end \- benchmarking, band construction, moderation, approval and communication \- with fluency in both India and US market benchmarks. Administer the ESOP programme: grant recommendations, board cadence, documentation and employee communication.
 



  





**Benefits and people operations** 




 Design and roll out benefits including retirement schemes and insurance for the India population, while coordinating with US\-side HR/legal on benefits parity and obligations where applicable. Own payroll governance and vendor performance across employee and contractor populations, onboarding, leave and holiday framework, and HRIS data integrity and access governance.
 



  





**Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Own worker classification policy and risk assessment across engagement models in both countries. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

title: HR Specialist/HRBP, Hyderabad
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
   

  

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:**
* To ensure workforce requirements are in sync with annual operating plan and organization \& operating structure from a perspective of layers, spans, etc.
* Work with talent acquisition partner to identify different available avenues for sourcing of right talent.
* Review profiles, interview candidates and roll out offers with talent acquisition


**Talent Management:**
* To execute the performance management process with regular touch bases and final evaluation as per the decided timelines, for the assigned region
* Facilitate discussions of low performers with their managers and ensure creation of performance improvement plan; Track achievement and take appropriate action in case of no visible increase in performance level
* Drive organization health \& manager connect surveys, as and when conducted, and ensure maximum coverage for the assigned region


**Business Partnering:**
* Maintain strong individual connect and regular touch points with all employees from the assigned business groups
* Solve for front\-line attrition by doing attrition analysis and taking corrective action
* Regular visit to sales offices in the regions and interact with the employees.
* Attend sales review meetings and market visits
* Own and interpret HR policy for the organization and resolve issues quickly and effectively.


 Address all employee queries and provide help/ support within decided timelines
   

  

**Qualifications**
* MBA \- HR from Tier 1 campus with proven working experience of 1\-3 years
* Exposure to start up environment is an added advantage
* Understanding of HR concepts and evolving HR practices

 This role ensures that approved capacity strategies are translated into structurally sound, compliant schedules (0–30 day horizon), proactively adjusted through weekly tactical steering, and actively protected through disciplined intraday performance management.
   

  

 Beyond operational oversight, the role operates as the Workforce Command Center lead — providing governance, decision control, and service protection during both stable and volatile operating conditions. It ensures workforce decisions are data\-informed, risk\-quantified, and aligned to service, productivity, and cost objectives.
   

  

 As part of the WFM Centre of Excellence (CoE), the role is accountable for embedding standardised workforce governance, decision frameworks, incident protocols, and execution discipline across Scheduling and Intraday functions. It drives the transition from reactive workforce administration to structured, analytics\-driven workforce control at scale.
   

  

 This position closes the loop between Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Intraday → Continuous Improvement, ensuring execution learnings systematically improve tactical and structural planning quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Capability Development
* Lead and develop Scheduling and Intraday WFM Specialists.
* Define clear accountability boundaries across tactical and real\-time scopes.
* Elevate analytical maturity beyond administrative execution.
* Coach team members in Scenario modelling, Workforce risk quantification, Structured incident response
* Build succession strength and capability depth.
* Foster a culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership.
* Tactical Planning \& Schedule Governance (0–30 Day Horizon)
* Own end\-to\-end schedule publication governance.
* Ensure schedules reflect approved capacity plans, are interval\-accurate and structurally optimised, comply with labour and contractual obligations
* Oversee scenario testing and trade\-off validation prior to release.

For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.
